generationMode: built-in ImageGen, one independent call per distinct asset

variants.primary: Build the biome's primary close-range earth identity from dense interlocking strata, embedded fragments, braided veins, and broad diagonal material flow. Mix fine, medium, and large features without a repeated grid.
variants.secondary: Build a clearly different secondary deposit from broken plates, fault breccia, swept sediment fans, cross-cut veins, and a contrasting feature orientation and scale. It must remain recognizably the same biome but not resemble the primary layout.

sharedPrompt.assetType: production full-coverage underground terrain material plate for UNDERSTAR gameplay
sharedPrompt.style: painterly high-detail premium dark-fantasy game ground material, realistic rock, soil, root, mineral, glass, bone, resin, or metal texture as appropriate; readable at gameplay zoom
sharedPrompt.composition: straight-on orthographic macro material surface, full-bleed edge-to-edge 1536x1024 landscape canvas, continuous visual density, no focal landmark and no empty area
sharedPrompt.lighting: even restrained raking light across the complete surface, dark but readable values, no center spotlight, no vignette, no horizon, and no baked rectangular frame
sharedPrompt.constraints: opaque material at all four edges and all four corners; no transparency or alpha cutout; no isolated formation; no cavern room, platform, architecture, arch, building, character, creature, ore node, resource, collectible, treasure, UI, icon, text, lettering, logo, watermark, border, contact sheet, or multiple variants in one image
